mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sh_report_agent_session ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, conversation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, batch_no VARCHAR(64), lybm VARCHAR(64), lymc VARCHAR(255), model_id VARCHAR(64), model_label VARCHAR(255), title VARCHAR(500), messages TEXT, update_time BIGINT, create_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, archived SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT uk_user_conv UNIQUE (user_id, conversation_id) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sh_report_agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM sh_report_agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sh_report_agent_session (user_id, conversation_id, batch_no, lybm, lymc, model_id, model_label, title, messages, update_time, archived) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{batchNo}, #{lybm}, #{lymc}, #{modelId}, #{modelLabel}, #{title}, #{messages,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{updateTime}, COALESCE(CAST(#{archived,jdbcType=SMALLINT} AS smallint), 0)) ON CONFLICT (user_id, conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET batch_no = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.batch_no, sh_report_agent_session.batch_no), lybm = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lybm, sh_report_agent_session.lybm), lymc = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lymc, sh_report_agent_session.lymc), model_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.model_id, sh_report_agent_session.model_id), model_label = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.model_label, sh_report_agent_session.model_label), title = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.title, sh_report_agent_session.title), messages = EXCLUDED.messages, archived = COALESCE(CAST(#{archived,jdbcType=SMALLINT} AS smallint), sh_report_agent_session.archived), update_time = GREATEST(COALESCE(sh_report_agent_session.update_time, 0), EXCLUDED.update_time)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sh_report_agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
